text:
tess (docs): opened a compact PR with a runnable SDK + curl examples for tier overrides, metering header, and a tiny dashboard ingest note. PR: https://git.redwood/rdw/docs/pulls/1497
arjun (eng): quick ask: which header should we canonically document? support sees both `X-Redwood-Meter` and `X-Redwood-Metering` in tickets
tess (docs): I've standardized on `X-Redwood-Metering` in the PR and left a compatibility note for `X-Redwood-Meter` (server accepts both). Example curl in the snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -H \"X-Redwood-Metering: team-alpha\" \n  -d '{"input":"summarize this"}'
```
leah (product): can you also show how partners can send per-request tier overrides? they asked for a short note about billing attribution when tier != account default
tess (docs): added JS and Python snippets showing per-request tier header and a one-liner about billing: "Tier overrides are billed at the request tier; meter attribution still follows the X-Redwood-Metering header." JS example added:```js
await client.request({
  path: '/generate',
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'X-Redwood-Metering': 'team-alpha', 'X-Redwood-Tier': 'enterprise' },
  body: { input: 'hi' }
});
```
michael (dev): small nit: in our ingestion lambda we currently surface the tier label as `tier_label` not `tier` or `tier_name`. We should either change docs or normalize ingestion. ops prefers docs note for now
leah (product): docs note is fine. please add a mapping line: `tier_label -> tier` for users mapping old dashboards
tess (docs): done. I added a short Grafana/PromQL snippet that uses `tier_label`:```promql
sum(rate(redwood_requests_total{job=\"ingest\"}[5m])) by (tier_label)
```
ci-bot: Docs PR #1497 preview: https://deploy.previews.redwood/docs/1497 expires in 48h
arjun (eng): i tested the sample payloads against staging. Meter counts are fine, but burst credits display under "Allowance" in the UI which confused the PM. Can you add 2-line explainer about burst credits vs quotas?
tess (docs): added a 2-line explainer: "Burst credits are temporary allowances that let requests exceed the configured tier rate for short windows. On the dashboard, burst usage is shown under Allowance and reconciled separately from allocated quota."
michael (dev): one more thing: include a 3-step migration checklist for customers moving from the legacy /ratecaps endpoint to the new tiered metering flow
tess (docs): added checklist (3 bullets): 1) start sending `X-Redwood-Metering` header with existing meter id, 2) map `tier_label` if your dashboard ingest uses the old field, 3) verify burst credit visualization in the Allowance panel after one day of traffic
leah (product): approved from product. wording is clear.
arjun (eng): left one inline comment about example timeout values in the JS snippet. otherwise LGTM from eng
tess (docs): thanks — I'll address the timeout nit and then request a final review from @michael. Will merge after a second reviewer. :thumbsup:
